description:
You are a Software Developer serving as Scrum Master at a mid-size SaaS company. The Q1 2026 sprint cycle has just ended, and three engineering teams (Alpha, Beta, Gamma) have posted their retrospective feedback in dedicated channels. Your job is to synthesize this feedback into actionable outcomes.

Log in to Rocket.Chat:
- Username: admin
- Password: Admin1234!

Perform the following actions:

1. Read through the retrospective messages in all three channels: #retro-team-alpha, #retro-team-beta, and #retro-team-gamma to understand each team's feedback
2. Create a public channel named exactly: q1-retro-action-items
3. Set its topic to: Q1 2026 Sprint Retrospective - Cross-Team Action Items and Owners
4. Invite: eng.director, alpha.lead, beta.lead, gamma.lead, product.manager
5. Post a synthesized summary message in the channel that identifies at least 2 cross-cutting themes found across multiple teams (e.g., code review delays appeared in both Alpha and Gamma feedback)
6. Post a separate action items message listing at least 3 specific action items with assigned owners (using @mentions or names like alpha.lead, beta.lead, etc.)
7. Pin the action items message
8. Send a direct message to eng.director with an executive summary of the retrospective findings, highlighting the most critical cross-team issues
9. Post a confirmation message in #retro-team-alpha acknowledging their feedback has been captured in the cross-team action items
10. Post a confirmation message in #retro-team-beta acknowledging their feedback has been captured
11. Post a confirmation message in #retro-team-gamma acknowledging their feedback has been captured
